big-agnes-copper-spur-hv-ul2: Roomy freestanding tent used for years; zippers fail.
big-agnes-copper-spur-ul1: Easy freestanding pitch and good storage; cramped for a quilt.
big-agnes-copper-spur-ul2: Roomy even for the tall; condensation and a floor that wets out.
big-agnes-fly-creek-ul2: Light and lasts a decade; tight for two, with little headroom.
big-agnes-rapide-sl-insulated: Raised rails suit side sleepers; colder than rated, some leaks.
big-agnes-tiger-wall-ul1: Light, easy and tough in wind; suits smaller hikers best.
big-agnes-tiger-wall-ul2: Very roomy for one on thru-hikes; zippers snag, fabric can tear.
durston-kakwa-40: Light frame loads the hips and it's roomy; small bottle pockets.
durston-kakwa-55: Carries heavy loads yet stays light; sweaty back, fit issues.
durston-wapta-30: Comfortable for frameless; the straps hurt as loads rise.
durston-x-dome-1: Roomy, freestanding and solid in weather; not the lightest.
durston-x-dome-2: Roomy with an easy pitch; poles bend in gusts, floors tear.
durston-x-mid-1: Big vestibules and storm-worthy; snug for taller hikers.
durston-x-mid-1-solid: Warm and windproof for the weight; stuffy in heat.
durston-x-mid-2: A palace for one, roomy for two; the footprint is hard to fit.
durston-x-mid-2-solid: Handles storms and cold; big footprint, stuffy when humid.
durston-x-mid-pro-1: Headroom and a low storm pitch; fussy on uneven ground.
durston-x-mid-pro-2: Light, storm-worthy and quick; big footprint, frail-seeming floor.
durston-x-mid-pro-2-plus: Room for two, a dog and gear; needs a large flat site.
enlightened-equipment-enigma: Light and packable; many find it colder than rated, with drafts.
enlightened-equipment-revelation: Light and versatile; many find it colder than rated, with drafts.
gossamer-gear-kumo-36: Comfortable frameless pack at a fair price; pockets tore for a couple.
gossamer-gear-mariposa-60: Light with roomy pockets; thin fabric tears, hip belt slips.
gossamer-gear-the-one: Quick pitch and roomy for the weight; condensation is the gripe.
gossamer-gear-thinlight-foam-pad: Protects and grips under an inflatable; too thin alone.
hyperlite-mountain-gear-20-degree-quilt: Warm near freezing and roomy for side sleepers; pricey.
hyperlite-mountain-gear-southwest: Tough and water resistant; shoulders hurt past 25 to 30 lb.
jetboil-minimo-cooking-system: Boils fast and simmers well enough for real cooking.
katabatic-gear-alsek-22-f-quilt: Properly warm below freezing with a pad attachment that works.
katabatic-gear-flex-15-f-quilt: Comfortable well below freezing; a few cold sleepers felt drafts.
katabatic-gear-flex-22-f-quilt: Warm into the teens and vents well; drafts are the gripe.
katabatic-gear-flex-30-f-quilt: A top pad attachment; needs a warm pad, too much for summer.
katabatic-gear-palisade-30-f-quilt: Warmer than rated with few drafts; narrow, with fiddly straps.
katabatic-gear-sawatch-15-f-quilt: Genuinely warm with few drafts; too warm in summer.
msr-pocketrocket-2: Tough, compact and reliable; slow and weak in wind and cold.
msr-pocketrocket-deluxe: Fast, simmers well and handles wind; the igniter fails early.
nemo-hornet-elite-osmo: Light, durable and storm-worthy, a favourite Hornet for several.
nemo-hornet-osmo: Roomy for its weight and dry in rain; the 1P is tiny.
nemo-switchback: Leak-proof foam, softer than rivals; bulky and firm for some.
nemo-tensor-all-season: Warm, light and packs small; noisy or leaky for a few.
nemo-tensor-elite: Tiny, light and comfortable; slippery, cool and puncture-prone.
nemo-tensor-extreme-conditions: Warm and comfortable on snow; complaints are rare.
osprey-exos-48: Great back airflow and lasts years; small, awkward hip pockets.
osprey-exos-58: Mesh back cuts sweat and fits a bear can; less comfy past 30 lb.
platypus-gravityworks: Filters lots of water fast for groups; clogs after storage.
platypus-quickdraw: Fast flow, integrity check and caps; some units are duds.
sawyer-squeeze: Long-lived and easy to backflush; it clogs after storage.
sea-to-summit-ether-light-xr: Very comfy for side sleepers, packs small; noisy and a bit heavy.
sea-to-summit-spark-pro: Vents on mild nights and stays warm when it turns cold.
six-moon-designs-gatewood-cape: Very light shelter that's also a poncho; weak in wind, damp.
six-moon-designs-lunar-solo: Roomy, light and good value; condensation, exact pitch needed.
soto-amicus: Compact, sturdy and good value; the igniter failed for a few.
soto-windmaster: Efficient, light and strong in wind; the igniter fails when wet.
tarptent-aeon-li: Very light solo tent, good in wind; snug for the tall.
tarptent-double-rainbow-li: Generous room for tall hikers; condensation is the main gripe.
therm-a-rest-neoair-xlite-nxt: Warm for the weight; narrow, slippery, and some leak.
therm-a-rest-neoair-xtherm-nxt: Very warm for its weight; side sleepers get hip pressure.
therm-a-rest-z-lite-sol: Tough foam that can't puncture; side sleepers get sore hips.
toaks-titanium-750ml-pot: A small stove and canister nest inside; narrow, uneven heat.
ula-circuit: Very durable and fits a bear can; comfort fades past 30 lb.
western-mountaineering-alpinlite: Accurate rating and generous cut; heavy next to quilts.
western-mountaineering-astralite-top-qui: Warm for its weight and well made; drafty at the shoulders.
western-mountaineering-megalite: Roomy, long-lived and cautiously rated; best near freezing for one.
western-mountaineering-summerlite: Light, small and durable; feels like a 40F bag to several.
western-mountaineering-terralite: Roomy and warm for restless side sleepers; heavy.
western-mountaineering-ultralite: Very warm for its weight; snug cut and shallow hood.
western-mountaineering-versalite: Cold sleepers love it and it lasts; overkill or bulky for a few.
zpacks-arc-haul-ultra: Comfortable and airy with heavy loads; worn stays and tears.
